**The one thing that's uneven:** Confucianism's side has no label. Adding `label: fortress-vs-threshold` there would make the two sides match. That's the only change I'd suggest.

**Both of these change the palace itself, which I can't do as a child.** With no Concierge, any change needs you to say "grow up." If you still want one link gone, that's your call on taste.
